description: Source code for LinearPlaybackControlJsonRpc class implementing JSON-RPC API for media playback control, including property registration, getter/setter methods, and demuxer interaction.

classes.name: LinearPlaybackControl
classes.description: Class implementing JSON-RPC API for media playback control, managing properties like channel, seek, trickplay, status, and tracing.

methods.name: callDemuxer
methods.description: Helper method to invoke a function on the demuxer instance, based on demuxerId.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC properties for the control interface.

methods.name: endpoint_set_channel
methods.description: Sets the channel URI for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_channel
methods.description: Gets the channel URI for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_set_seek
methods.description: Sets the seek position for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_seek
methods.description: Gets the seek position for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_set_trickplay
methods.description: Sets trickplay speed and direction for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_trickplay
methods.description: Gets trickplay speed and direction for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: endpoint_get_status
methods.description: Retrieves TSB status information for a specified demuxer.

methods.name: speedchangedNotify
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a change in speed.
